trees.description: New perks become available after feeding on enough corpses. Each new perk requires a few more feedings.

ranks.desc: As a Werewolf, you deal 25% extra damage.
As a Werewolf, you deal 50% extra damage.
As a Werewolf, your claw attacks deal Bleeding damage over 10 seconds.
As a Werewolf, your claw attacks deal extra Bleeding damage over 10 seconds.
As a Werewolf, your power attacks have a chance to knock enemies down.
Your Stamina Regeneration is increased by 50% in beast form and by 25% in mortal form.
Your Stamina Regeneration is increased by 100% in beast form and by 50% in mortal form.
Your Health Regeneration is increased by 50% in beast form and by 25% in mortal form.
Your Health Regeneration is increased by 100% in beast form and by 50% in mortal form.
Your Movement Speed is increased by 10% in beast form and in mortal form.
Your Movement Speed is increased by 10% and your unarmed damage is increased by 10 in beast form and in mortal form.
You learn the Howl of Terror.
You learn the Howl of Terror and the Howl of Rage.
You learn the Howl of the Pack.
You learn the Howl of the Pack and the Howl of the Moon.
As a Werewolf, your Howl cooldown is reduced by 25%.
As a Werewolf, your Howl cooldown is reduced by 50%.
As a Werewolf, when you fall below half Health, your Health regenerates twice as fast.
As a Werewolf, when you fall below half Health, you take 25% less damage from all sources.
As a Werewolf, your Movement Speed is increased by 20%.
As a Werewolf, your Health and Stamina are increased by 100.
As a Werewolf, your Armor Rating is increased by 100 and your Magic Resistance is increased by 25%.
